pair.title: Connect to Projector Control
pair.description: Your install line found Projector Control at {url}. Press Submit to connect. Change the address only if the server has moved.

key.title: Connect to Projector Control
key.description: In Projector Control open Settings > Home Assistant and press "Make a key". Copy the server address and the key from there into the boxes below.

reauth_confirm.title: Projector Control needs a new key
reauth_confirm.description: Projector Control at {url} no longer accepts Home Assistant's key. In Projector Control open Settings > Home Assistant, press "Make a key", and paste it here.

reconfigure.title: Change the Projector Control server
reconfigure.description: Leave the key empty to keep the one Home Assistant already has.

error.cannot_connect: Home Assistant could not reach Projector Control at that address. Check the server is on and the address is right.
error.invalid_auth: Projector Control did not accept that key. Make a new one under Settings > Home Assistant.
error.pairing_used: The install line's code was already used or is more than an hour old. Make a key in Projector Control (Settings > Home Assistant > Make a key) and paste it below.
error.unknown: Something unexpected went wrong. Check the address points at Projector Control.

abort.already_configured: This Projector Control server is already added.
